_comment: SHA-256 pins for the ffmpeg sidecar fetched by scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs, keyed by ffmpeg-<rust host triple>. SECOND pin layer on top of the per-archive SHA-256 in the script. ffmpeg 9.0.1 (2026-09-19; replaced the ffmpeg-static 6.1.1 binary). Same archives as SundayRec, so these are identical to the ffmpeg-* pins in sundayrec/scripts/ffmpeg-checksums.json, all computed on the owner's machine from archives first verified against the publishers' .sha256 files. Studio bundles no ffprobe.
